questions.question:
Study the following graph and answer the question based on the graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f0c46be74573c7ad20209fcd5a868c81ae3a93d3381199940812e8e9fe65c85.png] 

What was the percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Units produced on Friday = 50

Units produced on Friday = 30

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Decline = ((a – b)/a) × 100

**Calculations:**

Units produced on Friday = 50

Units produced on Friday = 30

Percentage Decline = ((a – b)/a) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = ((50 – 30)/50) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = (20/50) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = 40%

**∴ The percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday is 40%.**

questions.question: Salma buys an article and then sells if for Rs. 810. If she loses 10%, then at what price should she sell it to gain 4%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

At loss 10%, SP of article = Rs. 810

**Formula Used:**

SP = CP × (1 + P%/100)

SP = CP × (1 – L%/100)

where, SP → Selling Price, CP → Cost Price

**Calculations:**

At loss 10%, SP of article = Rs. 810

Now, SP = CP × (1 – L%/100)

⇒ 810 = CP × (1 – 10/100)

⇒ 810 = CP × (9/10) ----(1)

At gain 4%, 

SP = CP × (1 + 4/100)

⇒ SP = CP × (26/25) ----(2)

Dividing (2) by (1), we get

⇒ SP/810 = [CP × (26/25)]/[CP × (9/10)]

⇒ SP/810 = 104/9

⇒ SP = (104/90) × 810

⇒ SP = Rs. 936

**∴ The price at which Salma sells it to gain 4% is Rs. 936.**

questions.question: In how may years will a sum of Rs. 320 amount to Rs. 405 if interest is compounded at 12.5% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 320

Amount = Rs. 405

Rate of interest = 12.5%

**Formula Used:**

If am = aⁿ, then

m = n

Amount = P × (1 + r%/100)t

⇒ P → Principal, r% → Rate of interest per annum, t → Time period

**Calculations:**

Let the time period be t years.

Amount = P × (1 + r%/100)t

⇒ 405 = 320 × (1 + 12.5/100)t

⇒ 405/320 = (9/8)t

⇒ 81/64 = (9/8)² = (9/8)t

⇒ t = 2 years

**∴ The time in which a sum of Rs. 320 amount to Rs. 405 is 2 years.**

questions.question: The area of a square park is 16x² + 8x + 1. What is the length of the park?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of park = 16x2 + 8x + 1

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = (Side)²

**Calculations:**

16x2 + 8x + 1 = 0

⇒ (4x)² + 2 × 4x + (1)² 

⇒ (4x + 1)² 

Now, Area of square = (Side)2

⇒ Length of park = (4x + 1)

**∴ The length of the park is (4x + 1) units.**

questions.question: In a circle of radius 10 cm, PQ and RS are two parallel chords of lengths 16 cm and 12 cm, respectively. What is the distance between the chords if they are on opposite sides of the centre?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of circle = 10 cm

Length of PQ = 16 cm

Length of RS = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

AC² = AB² + BC²

where, AB, BC → Sides of a right-angled triangle, AC → Hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle

**Calculations:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae778c53ed1f11b4de37ea0991d31949fe6574bd32b6b6484d8e146eabe97705.png] **

Let O be the center of the circle.

In ΔOAP,

OP² = OA² + AP²

⇒ (10)² = OA² + (8)²

⇒ OA² = 100 – 64 = 36

⇒ OA = 6 cm

Similarly, In ΔOBR,

OR2 = OB2 + BR2

⇒ (10)2 = OB2 + (6)2

⇒ OB2 = 100 – 36 = 64

⇒ OB = 8 cm

Now, AB = OA + OB

⇒ AB = (6 + 8) cm

⇒ AB = 14 cm

**∴ The distance between the chords if they are on opposite sides of the centre is 14 cm.**

questions.question: The value of ? in sin 20° cos 70° + sin 70° cos 20° = ? is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin 20° cos 70° + sin 70° cos 20° 

**Concept Used:**

If (θ + α) = 90°, then

sinθ = cosα 

**Formula Used:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculations:**

Considering the given equation,

sin 20° cos 70° + sin 70° cos 20° = ?

Now, (20° + 70°) = 90° 

⇒ (sin 20°)² + (cos 20°)² = ? [cos70° = sin20°, sin70° = cos20°]

sin2θ + cos2θ = 1

**∴ The value of? is 1.**

questions.question:
In the given figure, PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral. What is the measure of the angle PQR if PQ is parallel to SR?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e8b593b7c30046bafd3bd2c5f0015a7921daed91f01270ced3a23577f28cb8.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠SPQ = 110° 

PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral

PQ || SR

**Concept Used:**

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles is 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab9a4160d0dae7b9348a66ae40c762bc73dbb3767d7f7dedb5031ee6b4c784f1.png] 

If AB || CD, then

θ + α = 180° 

**Calculations:**

In cyclic quadrilateral PQRS,

∠SPQ + ∠SRQ = 180° 

⇒ 110° + ∠SRQ = 180° 

⇒ ∠SRQ = 180° – 110° 

⇒ ∠SRQ = 70°

Now, ∠SRQ + ∠PQR = 180° 

⇒ 70° + ∠PQR = 180°

⇒ ∠PQR = 180° – 70° 

⇒ ∠PQR = 110°

**∴ The measure of the angle PQR is 110°.**

questions.question: A mobile phone was sold for Rs. 31,500 after giving two successive discounts of 30% and 10% respectively. What was the marked price of the mobile?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The selling price of a mobile phone is Rs. 31500 

Discounts offered were 30% and 10% 

**Concept used :**

Total discount = a + b – (a × b)/100 (where a and b are the discounts offered on the same item)

Selling price = marked price - discount on Marked price 

**Calculations :**

Total discount % = 30% + 10% – (30% × 10%)/100 = 37% 

According to the question,

⇒ 31500 = Marked price – discount on the marked price 

⇒ 31500 = Marked price – 37% of marked price 

⇒ 31500 = 63% of the marked price 

Marked price = (31500/63) × 100 

⇒ Rs. 50000 

**∴ The marked price of the item was Rs. 50000 ** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/377a7154a66c9f07e1ad135d4c442a1a8eacd2ca19c3ceeb0680385a3c8eec8d.png] 

**Concept used:**

S.P = M.P × (100 – D₁)/100 × (100 – D₂)/100

**Calculations:**

Let the Marked price be x 

S.P = M.P × (100 – D1)/100 × (100 – D2)/100

⇒ 31500 = x × (100 – 30)/100 × (100 – 10)/100

⇒ 31500 = x × 70/100 × 90/100

⇒ x = 5 × 100 × 100

⇒ x = 50000

∴ The marked price of the item was Rs. 50000

questions.question: If tan4A = cot(A – 20°), 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of A is:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

tan4A = cot(A – 20°)

**Formula used :**

tanθ = cot (90° – θ)

**Calculations :**

cot (90° – 4A) = cot (A – 20°)

⇒ 90°– 4A = A – 20° 

⇒ 5A = 110° 

⇒ A = 22° 

∴ **The value of A will be 22°**

questions.question: A and B separately can build a wall in 12 and 16 days, respectively. If they work for 1 day alternatively, starting with A, in how many days will the wall be built?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A can do a work in 12 days 

B can do the same work in 16 days 

They work on alternate days 

**Concept used :**

work done each day = total work/total number of days

**Calculations :**

Total work = LCM of 12 and 16 

⇒ 48 units 

A's per day work = 48/12 = 4 units 

B's per day work = 48/16 = 3 units 

Total work done in 13 days (7 days of A and 6 days of B) = 7 × 4 + 6 × 3 = 46 units 

Remaining work = 48 – 46 = 2 units 

Time is taken by B to complete the remaining work = 2/3 (B's turn to do the work)

⇒ 2/3 days

Total time taken = 13 + 2/3 

⇒ 13{2 over3} days

**∴ Total 13{2 over3} days will be taken to complete the work**

questions.question: The volume of a tank is 72 cubic meters. Water is poured into it at the rate of 60 liters per minute. How much time till it takes to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Volume of the tank = 72 m³

Water is poured at a rate of 60 litres/minute 

**Formula used :**

1 m³ = 1000 litres 

**Calculations :**

Total volume of Water (in litres) = 72 × 1000 = 72000 litres 

Total time taken = Total volume/Rate of water poured per minute 

⇒ Total time = 72000/60

⇒ 1200 minutes 

⇒ 20 hours (1 hour = 60 minutes) 

**∴ The total time taken was 20 hours **

questions.question: Given that 2²⁰ + 1 is completely divisible by a whole number, which of the following is completely divisible by the same number?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

2²⁰ + 1 is completely divisible by a whole number 

**Formula used :**

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² + b² - ab)

**Calculations :**

We will expand the numbers 

2⁹⁰ + 1 = 2⁹⁰ + 1⁹⁰ = (2³⁰ + 1)(2⁶⁰ + 1⁶⁰ - 2³⁰)

2¹⁵ + 1 = 2¹⁵ + 1¹⁵ = (2⁵ + 1) (2¹⁰ + 1¹⁰ - 2⁵)

2⁶⁰ + 1 = 2⁶⁰ + 1⁶⁰ = (2²⁰ + 1)(2⁴⁰ + 1⁴⁰ - 2²⁰)

We can see that in if a number divides (220 + 1) then it will surely divide (260 + 1)

∴ **The answer will be the option D **

questions.question: The volume of the water in two tanks, A and B, is in the ratio of 6 : 5. The volume of water tank A is increased by 30%. By what percentage should the volume of water in tank B be increased so that both tanks have the same volume of water?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The volume ratio of A, B is 6 ∶ 5

The volume of A is increased by 30%

**Calculation:**

Let the volume of A, B be 60, 50

New volume of A = 60(1 + 30/100) = 78

Difference between the volumes of A, B is 78 – 50 = 28

∴ Percentage Increase in volume = 100 × 28/50 = 56%

questions.question: What number must be added to each of the numbers 8, 13, 26 and 40 so that the numbers obtained in this order are in proportion?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Componendo dividendo rule

**Calculation:**

Let x be the number that to be added

⇒ (8 + x)/(13 + x) = (26 + x)/(40 + x)

By applying componendo dividend

⇒ (8 + x + 13 + x)/(13 + x – (8 + x)) = (26 + x + 40 + x)/(40 + x – (26 + x))

⇒ (21 + 2x)/5 = (66 + 2x)/14

⇒ 294 + 28x = 330 + 10x

⇒ 18x = 36

⇒ x = 2

∴ The number that should be added is 2.

questions.question: A player has a certain average for 15 innings. In the 16th inning, he scores 120, thereby his average increased by 6 runs. What is the new average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The score in the 16th innings is 120

The increase in average is 6

**Formula Used:**

Total score = Average × No. of Innings

**Calculations:**

Let the initial average be ‘k’

⇒ New average = k + 6

⇒ Total Score after 15 innings = 15k

⇒ Total Score after 16 innings = 16(k + 6) = 16k + 96

⇒ 15k + 120 = 16k + 96

⇒k = 24

⇒ k + 6 = 24 + 6 = 30

∴ New Average = k + 6 = 30

questions.question: If sin θ + cosec θ = 2, then the value of sin² θ + cosec² θ is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sinθ + cosecθ = 2

**Formula Used:**

cosecθ = 1/sinθ

**Calculation:**

Let sinθ = x

⇒ sinθ + cosecθ = x + 1/x = 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 2²

⇒ x² + 2 + 1/x² = 4

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 2

**∴ sin²θ + cosec²θ = 2**
